scope: Spanish second tier (Segunda División, now LALIGA HYPERMOTION) from 1929 to 2025-26. 1936-37 to 1938-39 not held (Civil War). Seasons played as groups plus a final group (1934-35, 1935-36, 1939-40 to 1942-43) have format "playoff", and places/points come from the final group. 1949-50 to 1967-68 were played in two parallel groups: one row per group, tournament "North" / "South", each with its own winner, runner-up and third. Title counts in the source list count each group win as a title
source: Wikipedia season articles (YYYY–YY Segunda División): league and group tables, points
https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Segunda_División_de_España_YYYY-YY (Spanish Wikipedia season tables: top three and points, every season 1929-2025-26; cross-check)
https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/span2champ.html (RSSSF champions and North/South group winners, every season; cross-check)
de.wikipedia / it.wikipedia season articles (tie-break for 1954-55 North)

fieldNotes.footsimuId: ESPN team id (the id FootSimu uses)
fieldNotes.footsimuSlug: club page slug on footsimu.com, only for clubs in a FootSimu league in 2026-27
fieldNotes.footsimuPath: club page path under the league the club plays in now, without locale
fieldNotes.points: final points (2 per win until 1994-95, 3 from 1995-96); final-group points for the "playoff" seasons
fieldNotes.name: club name used in the source for that season
fieldNotes.currentName: club as known today (FootSimu name where available); historic/defunct clubs and reserve teams are annotated
fieldNotes.tiedWith: not used (all level-on-points places were resolved by the official tie-breaks; see notes)
